clue.text: Hardly a bank on the west of Beirut

clue.text: Motion perhaps supporting graduate with two C's and a degree

explanation.walkthrough: 'Motion' is not a debating proposal but Andrew Motion, Britain's Poet Laureate 1999-2009.

clue.text: Continues to be entertained by house guests

E is the compass abbreviation for east

clue.text: Saw, for example, stolen goods returned

clue.text: Cliff in dispatch gets this cut of meat

explanation.definitionFit: Scrag end is the neck portion of a sheep carcass sold by butchers.

clue.text: Ignore traders and dig around, short of time

clue.text: Makes an effort to cross river for comrades

clue.text: What cyclist needs in case of slander?

clue.text: Disaster sees taxi reversing with learner into river

clue.text: Report of beer intended to generate complaint
